'''Mett Habble'''<ref name="BMF" /> was a [[human]]<ref name="Episode II" /> who served in the [[Royal Naboo Security Forces]]. They [[Death|died]] when [[Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala Naberrie|Padmé Amidala]]'s [[J-type diplomatic barge|ship]] was [[Plot to assassinate Senator Amidala|destroyed]] by [[Zam Wesell]] upon arriving to [[Coruscant]] so Amidala could vote on the [[Military Creation Act]].<ref name="BMF" />
